summary: Grayscale Litecoin Trust (LTC) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 regarding a change by the Index Provider (CoinDesk Indices, Inc.) to the Constituent Trading Platforms used to calculate the Index Price for the Trust. Effective May 19, 2026, OSL (LTC-USD trading pair) was added during a scheduled monthly review; no platforms were removed. This is an index composition update, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions. The filing is purely operational and routine for a crypto trust. No risk-arb angle exists.
